name: ai-scientist-evaluator
description: Critically review, score, compare, and rank one or more AI scientist outputs for biology, bioinformatics, computational life science, or adjacent research tasks. Trigger when the user asks to evaluate notebooks, code, figures, analyses, manuscripts, software, or final reports produced by AI scientists; compare multiple AI scientists on the same task; judge publication readiness; or audit rigor, reproducibility, novelty, and task completion. Do not use this skill to perform the original research task itself unless the user is explicitly asking for a reviewer-style audit of already produced outputs.
